validation.title: Validation Rules

description.crm: Check one field's value when a record is saved — refuse it, or warn and let the user decide — with your message. Add conditions so a rule applies only to some records, or call your own function to decide.
description.desk: Check one field's value when a ticket is saved and show your message instead of saving it. Scope a rule to departments, and apply it to the Help Center ticket forms too.

validation.emptyHint: Create one to stop records with wrong values from being saved.
validation.unreadable: This rule can't be applied (a field it uses changed or was deleted). Edit it to rebuild it.
validation.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Records will no longer be checked against it.

ops.gte: is greater than or equal to
ops.lte: is less than or equal to
ops.regexContains: contains a match of the pattern

regex.invalid: This pattern is not a valid regular expression.
regex.samplePlaceholder: Type a sample value to test the pattern
regex.wholeNo: The whole value does not match

function.hint: When a record is saved, its values are sent to your function, which answers success or an error message. If it can't be reached, the record is not saved.
function.secretNone: No secret — requests are not signed
function.secretWillReplace: The secret will be replaced on save
function.secretWillClear: The secret will be removed on save
function.testSavedHint: Tests the saved function settings — save changes first.
function.saveFirst: Save the rule first to test its function.
function.testFailed: The test could not be run.

result.unavailable: The function could not be reached

modal.name: Rule name

layoutHint.crm: “All layouts” checks records of every layout.
layoutHint.desk: The ticket layout the rule checks.

modal.primaryFieldHint: The rule checks this field's value.

fieldUnavailable.datatype: This field type can't be validated

modal.modeBlockHint: Show the message and keep the record unsaved.
modal.modeWarnHint: Show the message; the user may save anyway.
modal.fieldVerificationHint: Check the field as soon as the user changes it, and again on save.
modal.applyToHelpCenterHint: Also check tickets submitted from the Help Center ticket forms.
modal.placementTop: At the top of the form
modal.branchesHint: Checked in order: the first condition whose “Applies when” matches (or has none) decides, the rest are skipped.
modal.choosePrimaryFirst: Choose the field to check to add conditions.
modal.noOptions: This field has no values to choose from.
modal.customCheckHint: This check was built elsewhere and is kept as saved. Pick an operator to replace it.
modal.triggerOn: Show the error when the check
modal.serverProblems: The rule could not be saved:

problems.name: Enter a rule name.
problems.length: Enter a whole number (0 or more).
problems.fnTimeout: Enter a timeout between 500 and 10000 ms.

dependency.title: Map Dependency Fields
dependency.description: Limit the values of a child pick list by the value chosen in a parent pick list. A record whose child value is not allowed for its parent value is not saved.
dependency.emptyHint: Create one to offer only the child values that fit the parent value.
dependency.deleteMessage: Delete the dependency of {{child}} on {{parent}}? Any child value will be accepted again.

modal.noChildren: No other pick list of this module can depend on this field.
modal.gridHint: Tick the child values each parent value allows. A parent value with nothing ticked leaves the child unrestricted.
modal.serverProblems: The dependency could not be saved:

problems.values: Tick at least one allowed value.
